description: Temporal MAG with measured adjustment for latent T-Z confounding and a visibility witness R->T
law: z_i=i%2; t_i=0.3+0.4*z_i+0.05*sin(0.017*i); r_i=floor(i/2)%2; y_i=1+2*t_(i-1)+0.5*z_(i-1). R is a zero-coefficient visibility witness. Z and T share an exogenous cause.
oracle: Analytic coefficient of T in the lagged linear outcome equation; not a frozen implementation output
